costBoundAssumptions: Fixed recorded decisions, gross legs and proportional cost accounting; no price impact change.
Original per-block costs nonnegative and below NAV; aggregate retention certifies scaled positivity.
Bounds include adverse source rounding; they are not exact stressed NAV, MDD, tax or investor-return results.

decomposition.interpretation: Arithmetic active return includes allocation/beta/sector/timing and costs; residual is not an identified volatility contribution.

fallbackReplacement.interpretation: Same recorded starting stock targets; replacement of residual cash with ETF includes cost/drift/compounding interactions. It is not new stock selection.

method.annualBins: Assign each observed interval to END-date year, including boundary-straddling weeks; actual endpoints in CSV. 2013/2026 partial.
method.materiality: No economic threshold, alpha test, model selection or multiplicity claim; 1e-10pp only arithmetic tie tolerance.
method.recent: All observed intervals ending in 2024-2026, from last stored observation on/before 2024-01-01; no Jan1 interpolation.
method.risk: Weekly observed interval SD/downside RMS annualized by observed intervals/elapsed years; irregular spacing retained. Not daily volatility, daily CVaR, beta or selection alpha.
method.rolling: Reuse pinned #305 period records, validate against original NAV, add new mean-relative-wealth/benchmark-interaction decomposition. Calendar6/12m are not H126/H252.
method.sensitivity: Exactly all leave-one-year-out, largest-positive1/3 and most-negative1. Ex-post diagnostic. Remove BOTH legs and their elapsed days; remaining growth operators only, no missing-week NAV or tradable strategy created.
